Subject: Hightide renewal — draft staggered billing approach & legal ask

Folks — attaching the latest uplift proposal for Hightide (deal HTD-2026-0042). Key changes since the last version: 1) Term shifts to a rolling 12-month renewal with the first 6 months billed upfront and remaining 6 months billed as a scheduled stagger (see Exhibit A, section 2.1), 2) Coverage increase from 12M -> 18M token units at tiered pricing, 3) One-time migration discount applied to month 1.

Action items for this thread:
- Naomi: legal review of the new "staggered billing" clause and the proposed SLA carve (we surfaced a potential conflict with our standard credit cap). See redline file Exhibit-A_redline.docx.
- Ben: confirm revenue recognition note and whether accounting needs a PO amendment.
- Marissa: confirm go/no-go for committing the migration discount and signoff on the MutualActionPlan.

Attachments: Hightide_Uplift_OrderForm_v3.pdf (order form), Exhibit-A_redline.docx (legal redline), MutualActionPlan_2026.xlsx (timeline).

Short timeline: Hightide wants counterparty language back by 11/25 to keep launch in Dec. Im out at 4pm PT today — ping me if you need clarifications.

Thanks,

Subject: Hightide renewal — proposed amendment + staggered billing (attachments)

Hi Christine / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our alignment, attached is a single amendment that captures the uplift and the staggered billing schedule we discussed. Highlights:
- Contract term: 12-month rolling (effective 12/01/2026)
- Billing: Month 1 billed in full at contract execution, months 2-7 billed on a 60/40 cadence across the first 6 months (see Annex A schedule) to ease procurement timing, months 8-12 billed monthly thereafter
- Capacity: +50% token pool over baseline, with auto-scale thresholds and a 10% buffer pool for bursts
- Discount: one-time 15% migration credit applied to invoice 1

We tried to preserve your request to spread cost while keeping our standard invoice flow. Naomi is on CC for legal redlines (Exhibit-A_redline.docx); we flagged the SLA credit cap and exclusion language for your review.

Could you please confirm by 11/25 if the staggered schedule is acceptable or if procurement needs a single upfront PO? If acceptable, well prepare the DocuSign packet and route to your signers.

Attachments: Hightide_Uplift_OrderForm_v3.pdf, Exhibit-A_redline.docx, MutualActionPlan_2026.xlsx

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Subject: Re: Hightide renewal — proposed amendment + staggered billing (attachments)

Neha / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the documents with procurement and finance. A few notes:
1) Procurement would prefer a two-invoice approach (invoice 1 covers months 1-3, invoice 2 covers months 4-6) rather than the 60/40. That helps our mid-quarter cashflow.
2) Finance flagged the SLA credit cap: can we add language that ties total cumulative credits to a % of invoiced spend (we proposed 10% annual cap). Naomi, can you comment on operational exposure?
3) Procurement wants the migration credit applied pro-rata across the first two invoices rather than a single upfront credit.

Attaching Procurement_Response.pdf with redline comments inserted. If we can settle these items by COB Monday (11/29), we can route for signature the same week.

Thanks,
Christine Alvarez
Head of Platform Partnerships, Hightide Analytics

All — recommended internal posture: accept the two-invoice ask (months 1-3 / months 4-6) — its operationally neutral and simplifies reconciliation. For the SLA cap, propose the following compromise to legal: keep our standard incident-resolution SLA credit formula but add a hard cap equal to 10% of the annual invoiced amount (this mirrors Christines ask). Naomi: suggest the specific clause: "Aggregate SLA credits shall not exceed 10% of the total annual fees invoiced under this Agreement."

On the migration credit, we can split the 15% across the first two invoices (7.5% each) to align with procurement. Ben — confirm accounting impact (ARR recognition) but I dont expect a blocker. If all agree Ill have legal bake those three edits and we can send a clean set to Christine for approval.
